taunt: Lunch is served. You are the lunch.
I found this tray in the sewer. It is cleaner than you.
My sensei is a possum. Your sensei is a wall.
Hold still. I need to scrape you off the tray.
That smell is me. I live in a pipe. What is your excuse?
Pineapple goes on pizza. Fight me. Oh. You are.
Nobody named you after dumpster trash. Nobody loved you that much.
I ate a slice off the subway floor. Twice. I am unstoppable.
I do not do flips. I do falls that end well.
The tray says LUNCH. Upside down it says your name.
My brothers are coming. They are late. They are always late.
We are a team of four. The other three are getting pizza.
I was a lid. Now I am a leader. Same thing, more legs.
Say hi to the possum. He bites. So do I.
Rats are my friends. You are what the rats refuse.
I have a tail. Guess what it does. Nothing. Still have it.
Hairnet on. Health code says I can hit you now.
You just got served. By a tray. Literally.
I lick my own eyeballs. You are not scary.
Sewer rule one: do not touch the green stuff. I am the green stuff.
The cheese is three days old. So is your technique.
My shell did not ship. The tray fills in.
Second lunch is in five minutes. Fall down faster.
I am sixteen in gecko years. That is forty in yours. Respect your elders.
I have seen things in that pipe. You are not one of them.
Tray goes crack. You go down. Cafeteria physics.
Mushrooms are fine. Olives are a crime. Sit down.
Master Opossum said hit first, chew later.
Nobody lives in a sewer because they want to. I want to.
My reflexes are wet. Still faster than you.
I was raised in a storm drain. Thunder is my lullaby. You are a hiccup.
I can climb that wall. I am not going to. I am going to hit you.
This apron has four stains. One of them is you now.
The cutlery is plastic. The bruises are real.
Extra sauce. Extra you on the floor.
I shed my skin last week. You should try it. Yours looks used.
Four geckos, one pizza. That is why we fight.
Do not touch the tail. The tail is load-bearing.
I eat flies. Flies eat you. Food chain, pal.
Face down in a sewer is still face down.
The tray was clean. Was. Your fault.
I have been awake for three days. Pizza does that.
We named the rat Kevin. Kevin is tougher than you.
I serve pain with a side of tots.
My brothers call me Lidd. The possum calls me late.
Wall ninja, sewer ninja, lunch ninja. Pick one. I am all three.
The pipe smells better than this fight.
Everything down here is slippery. That includes your odds.
Hey. The tray is reusable. You are not.
You fight like someone who never licked a pole on a dare.
Anchovies are a cry for help. I am here to help.
I can regrow a tail. Can you regrow a face?
Nobody expects a tray. That is the whole point of a tray.
My sensei plays dead when the rent is due. I learned from the best.
I bruise green. You bruise worse.
The lunch bell rang. You are late and you are dinner.
Do not ask about the shell. There is no shell. Stop asking.
Lids keep things in. I keep you down.
Sewer water is just rain that gave up. Like you.
One slice left. Do the math. You lose.
I have a hairnet and a permit. The permit is fake. The hairnet is real.
You fight like you tip. Badly.
You taste like the mystery meat. I would know.
I will put you in the compost. The compost deserves better.
I licked a battery once. Still faster than this.
The possum says every fight ends in a nap. He is right about himself.
If you were a topping you would be a crayon.
Nothing on this tray is food. The tray is the food.
Cold pizza for breakfast. Warm faces for lunch.
Get back in the pipe. Not that pipe. The other pipe.
Strawe shot a spitball through a brick. I just hit people.
Napkin can lift a truck. Sporke can lift a spork. I lift the tray.
The possum had one bag: a lid, a spork, a napkin and a straw. Guess who got the lid.
The grease trap taught me patience. You taught me nothing.
I am going to stack you like trays.
Stop moving. The health inspector is watching.
My skin is grippy. Your face is not.
Why are you yelling? I can hear you through the walls. I live in the walls.
I slap with the tray. I bite only when the tray is in the wash.
The lunch lady said no running. She said nothing about this.
You are standing in my dinner. Move.
You are the worst thing I ever found in a dumpster. There was a couch.
I lost a toe to a rat trap. The rat lost worse.
Nobody steals a slice from the sewer. Nobody.
I flip you, not the tray. The tray is sacred.
I will tell the possum about this. He will play dead about it.
This counts as a flip. I am counting it.
Welcome to the cafeteria. The special is you.
Nothing personal. Everything tray.
My tail is cold. Your face will warm it up.
I keep a slice in my hairnet for emergencies. This is not one.
The sewer has rules. You just broke most of them.
I have eaten a fork. You are easy.
The pipe is home. The street is lunch.
A gecko never forgets a topping fight.
You smell like someone who throws away the crust.
You are fighting a lunch tray. Think about that. Really think about it.
When I win, I get the corner slice. I always win.
I am faster than a wet floor sign.
Tray face. Say it. Tray face.
continue: Pineapple. I said pineapple. Insert a coin and we settle this.
Napkin says olives. Olives! Put in a coin before he wins.
One quarter and the sausage question stays open.
Sporke voted anchovies. Sporke is wrong. Coin, now.
Half mushroom, half nothing. Nothing is a topping. Insert coin.
We cannot split four ways on a dead gecko. Coin.
The possum wants plain cheese. The possum does not get a vote. Coin.
I am not getting up until someone admits peppers are a lie.
Strawe ordered extra sauce. On a dead guy. Insert a coin.
Ten seconds to pick a topping. Ten seconds to pick a coin.
Extra cheese or no continue. Those are my terms.
The crust is not a topping. Fight me when I am up. Coin.
Put in a quarter and I will stop talking about olives. For a bit.
Whoever pays picks the topping. Nobody is paying. That is the problem.
Deep dish is a casserole. Put in a coin before Napkin hears me.
ending: Lidd went home to the pipe and found the other three had eaten his slice. The fight continues.
Lidd won the toppings argument. Pineapple, for the record. Nobody spoke to him for a week.
Lidd returned the tray to the cafeteria. The lunch lady charged him for 996 games of wear.
Master Opossum played dead through the whole ending. He woke up for the pizza.
Lidd hung his hairnet on the cabinet. Health code says it stays there now.
The Geckos opened a pizza place in the sewer. The reviews mention the rats, warmly.
Lidd regrew his tail twice during the credits. He is fine. It is fine.
The sewer flooded. Lidd surfed home on the tray and called it training.
Lidd found a new lid in the dumpster. He named it. He will not say what.
Lidd beat 996 bootlegs and still cannot do a flip. He is at peace with the falls.
The lunch tray retired to a wall in the pipe. Lidd salutes it before every meal.
Kevin the rat got a slice for his service. Kevin had earned it.
